source_handling.reason: The Nexus author requires permission before assets are reused in another mod.
source_handling.archive_version: 7.04; user selects their own ZIP locally

human_steps: Install Surveyor 0.3.51 with Check app update > Install update.
Start NMS once, then fully close NMS, so the game MODS path is recorded.
Download the mod ZIP for personal use from Nexus Mods.
Click Install Derelict Farming archive and select the ZIP.
Fully restart NMS; use the scanner, activate pulse within 10 seconds, finish the derelict, then repeat in the same system.
rollback: Run python tools/github_integration.py rollback-derelict-farming from the Surveyor project folder.
